messages.subject: contribute to methylKit development via github
parts:
You can contribute to the methylKit development via github by checking out "development" branch, making your changes and doing a pull request (all of these should be done on the "development" branch NOT on the "master" branch). http://github.com/al2na/methylKit/ 
Depending on the extent of your changes, you may be asked to write documentation and/or do R CMD CHECK.

Best,
Altuna
